title: Suite definition (suite.json)
description: Root file of a frozen task suite. The cohort key is a projection of this file plus the digest of the whole suite tree.

infra.description: Rules for provider-side failures. Decided by trusted components only; the submitter has no choice to make.

upstream_retries.description: Transparent gateway retries for upstream 5xx, 429 and transport errors.

max_reruns_per_rep.description: Fresh re-runs of a rep whose attempt hit an upstream error after retries.

max_rerun_permille.description: Cap on infra re-runs per run (the sum of attempts - 1 over all reps), in permille of all reps. A run over the cap cannot be sealed.

protected_paths.description: Restored from the pristine repo before grading, so edits to them have no effect on the verdict.

ignore_paths.description: Caches and other leftovers that are not edits (bytecode, test-runner caches). Dropped when a workspace is snapshotted, so they never enter a patch.

tasks.description: Sorted by id. At most 256 because each task is one job in a GitHub Actions matrix.
